items.title: AI for Science expands to foundations and research institutions

score.summary: Anthropic expands its AI for Science credit program to 20 foundations, institutions and research groups.
score.whyItMatters: Funding and partnership news for science researchers; no Claude Code or agentic coding practice for this reader.

items.title: IDC brings Quanta into Claude and adopts Claude across the company

score.summary: IDC launches an IDC Quanta MCP connector for Claude and reports internal Claude Code and Cowork productivity claims.
score.whyItMatters: An MCP connector for market research, but the productivity figures are unmeasured customer-style claims with no method.

items.title: Software engineering at Google & CS education with Titus Winters

score.summary: Pragmatic Engineer interview with Titus Winters on Google-scale refactoring, mandatory testing, and AI-driven outage increases.
score.whyItMatters: Useful framing on verification and test discipline for agent output, though mostly anecdotal with no reusable config.

items.title: [AINews] Gemini 4 Carbon tops leaderboards, launches for cyber defenders

score.summary: Roundup of Google's Gemini 4 Carbon launch and leaderboard results, mostly aggregated from social posts and vendor claims.
score.whyItMatters: Model-comparison news; the coding-agent gap versus Claude Code is secondhand and harness-dependent, so not actionable.

score.summary: Podcast on why coding agents favor Supabase, covering Docker-free local runtime, declarative schemas in Git, and compute.
score.whyItMatters: Backend-for-agents context; the declarative-schema-in-Git idea is worth a look but the content is mostly commentary.

items.title: The October inflection point for vibe game development

score.summary: Simon Willison argues Opus 5.5 can now build fun browser games from vibe prompts, showing four examples.
score.whyItMatters: Vibe-coded game demos without a reusable engineering technique are outside this reader's interests.

items.title: chore(badge): update Last Updated badge to Oct 29, 2026 11:33 AM PKT … (+10 more)

score.summary: Automated commit log from a Claude Code best-practices repo noting a new /design command and badge bumps.
score.whyItMatters: Routine repo maintenance noise; the only possibly useful bit is an unverified /design command mention.

items.title: Claude Code regularly sends each background agent’s transcript to its model

score.summary: Claude Code sends every background agent's transcript to its model every 30s for status summaries; a Bun preload disables it.
score.whyItMatters: Measured via OpenTelemetry at roughly 16-26% of spend, with a concrete preload fix and verification steps for daily Claude Code use.
score.tryThis: Add --preload no-agent-summary.js to BUN_OPTIONS, restart daemon, verify log shows preload active.

score.summary: GitHub Octoverse 2026 reports merged PRs tripled to 220M/month and commits to 7.38B/month, with methodology notes.
score.whyItMatters: Ecosystem-scale data on agentic engineering volume; useful context for multi-repo work, not a technique.
